proof_scope: Model-specific ISA control routing, coupled in XSIM to the existing bank_ownership_table and this revision's bank_tensor_state_tracker. DMA and compute completions are simulated; no tensor data ports or arithmetic are present.

checks.template_extension: generator asserts source identity outside USER markers and the module name
checks.verilator_lint: PASS; only inherited unused bank_owner_port warning

xsim_scenarios: two embedding-row DMA_LOAD records make B0 valid only on the final completion
two GEMM N tiles make B4 valid only on the final completion
GEMM request and payload remain stable through three ready-backpressure cycles
FENCE waits for a delayed DDR S2MM response
END/DONE followed by a new BRAM chunk preserves valid B4 without reset
DMA_STORE from an invalid bank fails before request acceptance
RMSNORM, ROPE, ATTN_SCORE, SOFTMAX, ATTN_VALUE, ADD and SILU_MUL route to their compute channels
a mismatched DMA completion tag does not release its bank; a subsequent matching response drains to an error
a failed matched GEMM completion releases all owned banks and invalidates its destination
limitations: The testbench simulates DataMover and compute responses; it does not verify real DDR, bank data, numeric results or compute executors.
This tests representative legal records and error paths, not an exhaustive sweep of every encoded operand shape.
OOC timing has no HD.CLK_SRC, no placed or routed clock, and no full-chip timing evidence.
No BIT, HWH, XSA, Vitis application or physical-board execution is claimed.
